db_subject: Structure-Activity Relationship of New Chimeric Analogs of Mastoparan from the Wasp Venom Paravespula lewisii.
db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (90.48%) to MP-RIP L=A=K: 19%, I: 14%, N: 10%. Activity: Active against S. aurerus (MIC 27.8 uM) and E.coli (MIC 109.8 uM). Structure: helical in 50% TFE.
